name: godot-csharp-generator-pilot
provenance: Original prompts, targets, and evaluation briefs authored for this repository; no external code snippets copied.
purpose: Exercise the prompt-conditioned NCM generator pipeline and establish a tiny held-out smoke set.
limitations: Tiny synthetic smoke set; not a capable code-training corpus.
The 64-token target cannot contain a complete game or project.
No automated generated-code execution evaluator is included yet.
Keep test.jsonl held out from training and tuning.
